CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListFindNoCase

Returns the position of the first element of a list that is equal to the given value, without regard to upper or lower case. If there is no such element, the result is 0.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListFindNoCase(list, value [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list to search.
value
The element to look for.
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters of the list; the default is a comma.

Returns

The index of the matching element, or 0.

Usage

Good for checking user input against a list of allowed values. ListFind is the case-sensitive version.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Allowed = "Netscape;Explorer;Opera">
<CFSET Tests = "netscape,EXPLORER,Mosaic">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Browser</TH><TH>ListFind</TH><TH>ListFindNoCase</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="B" LIST="#Tests#">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>#B#</TD><TD>#ListFind(Allowed, B, ";")#</TD><TD>#ListFindNoCase(Allowed, B, ";")#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also

ListFind, ListContainsNoCase, ListValueCountNoCase, CompareNoCase
